title: Customer service
description: Manage the contacts displayed on the storefront Help page. Hidden contacts are not published. Scheduled availability describes service hours, not live presence.
name: Name
empty: No contacts yet. Add your pre-sales and after-sales team members.
requestError: Unable to load or save contacts. Please try again.
validation: Enter a name, at least one valid contact method, a valid time zone, working days, and an end time after the start time. Use 7–15 digits with country code for WhatsApp.
hoursHelp: Use local times in the specified time zone, for example Asia/Shanghai or Europe/Copenhagen. Split overnight coverage across contacts if needed.
